waivers.reason: Vercel58.5.1 has fixed Zod3.22.4 dependencies with no upstream compatible patch; the latest Vercel release also retains these Zod3 dependencies. A forced Zod3-to-4 replacement is not treated as compatible remediation.
waivers.mitigation: Keep this exact development-only dependency graph and advisory bound; do not run Vercel dev/build against untrusted repositories. Normal PR quality does not deploy. Production high/critical and any additional advisory remain blocking. Revisit before expiry or any dependency change.

reachability.production: No application/API import of vercel or zod; npm audit --omit=dev is independently required to have no high/critical vulnerabilities.
reachability.release-tool: The Vercel CLI is used by the protected artifact build, prebuilt deployment and prepared promotion paths. Zod3 parsing remains reachable for local manifests and backend introspection if general Vercel dev/build is invoked; this exception does not declare that usage safe.
reachability.test: Normal PR quality runs verification and fixture tests, not a real Vercel deployment or development server.
reachability.build: The application is a static Vite/PWA build; development CLI builder schemas are not bundled into the application.
